'''2000 New Jersey State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Cedar Grove, NJ on 8 April 2000. [[Scott Lingrell]] won it. It is known from Chris Gogolen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d489">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-09-cedar-grove-new-jersey-4-8-00d489/ cedar-grove-new-jersey-4-8-00], DeckTech (Chris "CGogolen" Gogolen, 9 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-09-cedar-grove-new-jersey-4-8-00d489/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 8 April 2000
* '''Site:''' Cedar Grove, NJ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 19
* '''Winner:''' [[Scott Lingrell]]
